questions.prompt: Which overall plan matches the sort candidates by priority approach for Design Twitter?

choices.label: Rank candidates by tweet ID instead of posting time.
choices.feedback: Tweet identifiers do not define recency.

choices.label: Include only followed users' tweets and omit the user's own tweets.
